claim: The S3 User Guide overview says S3 Express One Zone is the lowest latency cloud object storage class available today, with data access speeds up to 10x faster and request costs 80 percent lower than S3 Standard.
question: How much faster and how much cheaper per request is S3 Express One Zone than S3 Standard, per the S3 User Guide?

qualifiers.scope: S3 Express One Zone storage class

evidence.quote: S3 Express One Zone is the lowest latency cloud object storage class available today, with data access speeds up to 10x faster and with request costs 80 percent lower than S3 Standard.

note: adjudicate-21: replaces s3-express-one-zone-10x-faster-50-percent. The storage-class-intro page still says 50 percent; the Welcome page says 80 percent after the 2025-04-10 Express One Zone price cut (see s3-change-express-one-zone-price-cut-2025-04).
